basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Security Officer, Biomedical Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Security Officer, Biomedical Engineer, Laundry Manager and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar (AIIMS Deoghar), Jharkhand, has invited applications for 4 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. AIIMS/Deo/Cont. Rect./Non-Faculty/2/2026/ 04. The posts include Security Officer, Biomedical Engineer, Laundry Manager, Perfusionist. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 18 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft only in favour of AIIMS Deoghar payable at Deoghar, submitted in original with the application form.

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview & document verification.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in.
Fill in the application form duly.
Send the duly filled application in offline mode to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar, At- Devipur Campus, Ramsagar, Deoghar-814117, Jharkhand.
Send the original demand draft of the application fee along with the application form.
Annex attested photocopies of degrees, certificates, mark sheets, age proof and caste certificates to the hard copy of the application.
Those working in Central/State Government/Semi Government Autonomous body enclose a No Objection Certificate from their organization.
Make sure it reaches by 18 December 2026.
important_instructions: Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; the Executive Director reserves the right to vary vacancies including reserved vacancies. Fee once remitted will not be refunded. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Corrigenda and updates will be posted on www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Security Officer: Government servants, SC, ST, OBC as per Govt. of decision from time to time. Age relaxation, Biomedical Engineer: Government servants, SC, ST, OBC as per Govt. of decision from time to time. Age relaxation, Laundry Manager: Government servants, SC, ST, OBC as per Govt. of decision from time to time. Age relaxation, Perfusionist: Employees of AIIMS up to 40 years, Government servants, SC, ST, OBC as per Govt. of decision from time to time. Other conditions: Candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi Government Autonomous body must submit a No Objection Certificate from their organization with the application. content_sections.text: Candidates convicted by any Court of Law Candidates who canvass in any way are disqualified

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Degree from a recognized University/ equivalent; Officers of the Police Departments of the Central/ State/ UT Governments or Officers of the Armed Forces including Para Military Forces, holding analogous posts or with 2/3 years regular service in a post in PB-2 GP 4800/ GP 4600 or above, preferably having experience connected with security, handling agitations and strikes of employees. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: 91443. Qualification required: B.E/B. Tech in Bio Medical Engineering from a recognized Institution/ University; Or Diploma in Bio Medical Engineering from a recognized Institution with 2 years experience in relevant field. Experience required: 2 years experience in relevant field (for the Diploma route). Age limit: 21 to 35 years. Pay: 73187. Qualification required: 12th pass or its equivalent from a recognized Board/School; Diploma/ Certificate in Dry Cleaning/ Laundry Technology from a recognized Institute; 12 years experience in a reputed mechanized Laundry. Experience required: 12 years experience in a reputed mechanized Laundry. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: 57702. Qualification required: B.Sc. Degree from a recognized University; Certificate in Perfusion Technology (awarded by a recognized Institution/ Association/ Authority (Such as Association of Thoracic and Cardio Vascular Surgeons of India) after a training in a Centre. Experience required: At least one year experience in Clinical Perfusion; desirable: working experience in Clinical Perfusion. Age limit: 18 to 30 years. Pay: 57702.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated pay per month; no other allowances will be paid. Contract for 11 months or till regular appointment, whichever is earlier, from the date of joining. Notice says the contract is further extendable on yearly basis on performance; if not extended it lapses automatically. Either side may terminate at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary. Post cannot be regularized at any stage and is not linked to regular appointment. No Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority or Promotion. No other allowances are paid; the pay is consolidated.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft only in favour of AIIMS Deoghar payable at Deoghar, submitted in original with the application form.

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Deoghar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification Walk-in interview Shortlisted candidates will be informed through mail about document verification and interview. Original and photocopy of educational/experience documents are to be produced at the time of interview. Date and time of document verification and interview are not printed in the notice.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview & document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original demand draft of the application fee in favour of AIIMS Deoghar payable at Deoghar Attested photocopies of degrees, certificates, mark sheets, age proof and caste certificates Certificate in respect of date of birth Experience certificate after completion of the qualification Caste certificate issued by Govt. of India, if applicable No Objection Certificate, if working in a Govt./ Autonomous Institute

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in. Fill in the application form duly. Send the duly filled application in offline mode to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Deoghar, At- Devipur Campus, Ramsagar, Deoghar-814117, Jharkhand. Send the original demand draft of the application fee along with the application form. Annex attested photocopies of degrees, certificates, mark sheets, age proof and caste certificates to the hard copy of the application. Those working in Central/State Government/Semi Government Autonomous body enclose a No Objection Certificate from their organization. Make sure it reaches by 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; the Executive Director reserves the right to vary vacancies including reserved vacancies. Fee once remitted will not be refunded. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Corrigenda and updates will be posted on www.aiimsdeoghar.edu.in.
